subject: axolotl
title: This Animal Regrows a Leg, a Heart Piece, Even Brain

scenes.text: Cut off this animal's leg, and it grows back perfectly.
It is the axolotl, a Mexican salamander that never needed a hospital.
It can regrow a lost leg, parts of its heart and spinal cord, and even sections of its brain.
And there is no scar. Where we would heal with scar tissue, it rebuilds the real thing.
Scientists at the Marine Biological Laboratory are mapping the molecular switch that makes it possible.
Scientists hope that understanding the switch could one day help repair human injuries.

description:
